title: Concept: Distribution declares no interpreter floor
description: setup.cfg declares a setup.cfg with no `python_requires`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a setup.cfg with no `python_requires`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through setup.cfg (pypi).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a setup.cfg with no `python_requires`.
